AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
January 8, 2020
07:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Case No.: LLA-2019-01 Location: 501 W. Foothill Boulevard, Azusa CA 91702
APN: 8605-003-032
Applicant: Jacob Glaze (Kimely-Horn)
The City of Azusa received a request for a Lot Line Adjustment (LLA-2019-01) for a proposed lot line adjustment to modify the northernmost lot line on the property (APN: 8605-003-032).
This project is categorically exempt from environmental review per Class 5 Categorical Exemption (State CEQA Guidelines, § 15305), (California Environmental Quality Act).

Case No.: UP-2019-06 Location: 1388 W. Foothill Blvd., Azusa CA 91702
APN: 8616-001-022
Applicant: David Banducci (Able Card LLC)
The City of Azusa received a request for a Use Permit (UP-2019-06) to operate business outside of the normal hours of operation, from Sunday to Saturday (work week) 5:30 am to 10:00 pm.
This project is categorically exempt from environmental review per Class 1 Categorical Exemption (State CEQA Guidelines, § 15301) Class 32 Categorical Exemption (State CEQA Guidelines, § 15332), (California Environmental Quality Act).

Case No.: Code Amendment No. 246 Location: City of Azusa
APN: N/A
Applicant: City of Azusa
The City of Azusa is proposing a Code Cleanup for Chapter 88 of the Azusa Municipal Code (Development Code).
This proposal is exempt from environmental review because the proposed action is not considered a “project,” per Section 15378 of the CEQA Guidelines.
